predictor.notes: Prices are in pence. This continuous three-region affine predictor was selected using quantization intervals, not by treating rounded estimates as exact prices. It matches all 120 observed quantities: the exact approvals at 50 (76321) and 200 (131071), plus all 118 estimates after applying their disclosed quantizers. Exact reconstruction is not uniquely identifiable. Conditional on a continuous three-region affine model with the selected initial line, the second change can occur after quantities 527–550, and compatible prices at quantity 1000 span approximately 225740–227278 pence; this predictor gives 226497. No remaining estimate quantity separates those surviving continuous-affine candidates under the available precision policy, so further queries would not resolve that ambiguity. The selected coefficients and change points are estimates; additional nonlinear structure or discontinuities remain possible.
